panels.title: How to use this dashboard
panels.description: Dashboard notes and operating guidance.

options.content:
### Purpose
At-a-glance production platform health and restore confidence for Conorganizer.

Use this dashboard from top to bottom: **current status -> backups -> filesystem capacity -> VPS resources -> SQLite -> HTTP/TLS -> system errors**.

Design choices:
- Infrastructure panels follow USE: utilization, saturation, and errors.
- Service-facing panels use public blackbox probes for symptoms before digging into causes.
- Backup freshness status uses Loki success logs first; the backup age panels read the `conorganizer_*` textfile metrics that the backup scripts write after each successful run.
- Loki panels should work with broad `job` labels; narrow `loki_job` after import if labels are available.
- Prometheus panels require node_exporter, blackbox_exporter, and systemd collector metrics.
- SQLite, WAL, backup and backup directory sizes come from the same textfile metrics and update with every successful SQLite backup.

Useful external examples:
- Node Exporter Full: https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/1860-node-exporter-full/
- Prometheus Blackbox Exporter: https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/14928-prometheus-blackbox-exporter/
- Caddy Monitoring: https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/22806-caddy-monitoring/
- Loki Dashboard: https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/13186-loki-dashboard/

panels.title: Main website probe
panels.description: Requires blackbox_exporter. Shows whether the public main website probe is currently succeeding.

panels.title: Grafana probe
panels.description: Requires blackbox_exporter. Shows whether the public Grafana probe is currently succeeding.

panels.title: Caddy active
panels.description: Requires node_exporter systemd collector metrics. Alert candidate: Caddy not active.

panels.title: Main service active
panels.description: Requires node_exporter systemd collector metrics. Alert candidate: conorganizer-main.service not active.

panels.title: SQLite backups, 2h
panels.description: Log-derived count of successful SQLite backups in the last 2 hours using the stable backup prefix. Green means at least one recent success; "SQLite backup age" below shows the exact time since the last success. Red 0 means no successful backup in 2 hours.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$loki_job", service="conorganizer-sqlite-backup"} |= "conorganizer-sqlite-backup: completed successfully" [2h])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Image backups, 26h
panels.description: Log-derived count of successful image backups in the last 26 hours using the stable backup prefix. Green means at least one recent success; "Image backup age" below shows the exact time since the last success. Red 0 means no successful backup in 26 hours.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$loki_job", service="conorganizer-images-backup"} |= "conorganizer-images-backup: completed successfully" [26h])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Mounted volume usage
panels.description: Requires node_exporter filesystem metrics with /mnt not excluded. Alert candidate: >80%, critical around 90%.

panels.title: Backup failures, 24h
panels.description: Failed backup runs in the last 24 hours, counted from the 'Failed with result' line systemd writes once for every failed SQLite or image backup run, whatever the cause. Green should be zero.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$loki_job", service=""} |~ "conorganizer-(sqlite|images)-backup.service: Failed with result" [24h])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Critical system log signal, 1h
panels.description: Signs of serious trouble in the last hour: units failing to start, crash-loop restarts (Scheduled restart job), I/O errors, full disks and Go panics. Ignores openipmi, which always fails on this VPS. Green should be zero.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$loki_job", service!~"loki|grafana-server"} |~ "Failed to start|Scheduled restart job|Start request repeated too quickly|I/O error|(?i:no space left on device)|panic:" != "openipmi" [1h])) or vector(0)

panels.title: TLS days: main
panels.description: Requires blackbox_exporter TLS probe metrics. Alert candidate: less than 14 days.

panels.title: Root filesystem usage
panels.description: Used space on / (/dev/sda1, 40 GB). Loki keeps its data on this disk in /var/lib/loki, up to 120 days of logs.

panels.title: Logs reaching Loki
panels.description: conorganizer-main log lines in the last 5 minutes. The uptime check alone writes about 20. No logs means Alloy is not shipping the journal: check alloy.service.

panels.title: Failed services
panels.description: Our systemd services in the failed state. Run systemctl --failed on the server to see which.

panels.title: SQLite backup logs
panels.description: Stable prefix emitted by the SQLite backup script. Use this to confirm recent backup activity and integrity-check output.

panels.title: Image backup logs
panels.description: Stable prefix emitted by the image backup script. Use this to confirm daily image backup activity.

panels.title: Backup failure count
panels.description: Failed backup runs per 15 minutes, from the 'Failed with result' line systemd writes for each failed SQLite or image backup run. A flat 0 line means no failures.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$loki_job", service=""} |~ "conorganizer-(sqlite|images)-backup.service: Failed with result" [15m])) or vector(0)

panels.title: SQLite backup age
panels.description: Hours since the last successful SQLite backup, from conorganizer_sqlite_backup_last_success_timestamp_seconds. conorganizer-sqlite-backup runs every 15 minutes, so the line should stay under 0.25 h. Above the red line at 0.5 h a run has failed or the timer has stopped; Backup failure logs shows why.

panels.title: Image backup age
panels.description: Hours since the last successful image backup, from conorganizer_images_backup_last_success_timestamp_seconds. conorganizer-images-backup runs daily at 03:30, so the line should stay under 24 h. Above the red line at 26 h a run has failed or was missed; Backup failure logs shows why.

panels.title: Backup directory size
panels.description: Disk space used by /mnt/HC_Volume_103911252/backups (SQLite and image backups), from conorganizer_backup_directory_size_bytes. conorganizer-sqlite-backup measures it after each successful run. Backups older than 14 days are deleted, so the line should level off; steady growth means the cleanup is not working or the backups are getting larger.

panels.title: Successful backups
panels.description: Successful backup runs per interval, from the backup services' own log lines. The SQLite backup should appear 4 times an hour and the image backup once a day; a gap means missed backups.

panels.title: Backup failure logs
panels.description: Every line the backup jobs wrote except the three normal ones (started, created, completed successfully): script errors, integrity-check output and stderr from sqlite3, zstd, tar or cp. Empty (No data) means no backup problems.

panels.title: Root filesystem usage
panels.description: node_exporter filesystem usage for /. Watch for sustained growth.

panels.title: Mounted volume usage
panels.description: node_exporter filesystem usage for the Hetzner volume. Requires node_exporter to include /mnt mountpoints.

panels.title: Mounted volume available bytes
panels.description: Available bytes on the mounted Hetzner volume.

panels.title: Root inode usage
panels.description: Inode exhaustion can break writes even when bytes are still available.

panels.title: Mounted volume inode usage
panels.description: Inode usage on the mounted Hetzner volume.

panels.title: Mounted volume used bytes
panels.description: Used bytes on the mounted Hetzner volume. This avoids counter functions on filesystem gauges and shows the capacity trend directly.

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: CPU utilization from node_exporter. This is a USE utilization signal.

panels.title: Memory usage
panels.description: Memory capacity utilization from node_exporter.

panels.title: Load average 1m
panels.description: CPU saturation proxy. Compare with CPU count in node_cpu_seconds_total if this becomes concerning.

panels.title: Network receive rate
panels.description: Network ingress throughput excluding common local/container interfaces.

panels.title: Network transmit rate
panels.description: Network egress throughput excluding common local/container interfaces.

panels.title: SQLite DB file size
panels.description: Size of /mnt/HC_Volume_103911252/environments/main/database/events.db, from conorganizer_sqlite_db_size_bytes. conorganizer-sqlite-backup measures it after each successful run, every 15 minutes.

panels.title: SQLite WAL file size
panels.description: Size of main's events.db-wal, from conorganizer_sqlite_wal_size_bytes, measured after each successful SQLite backup. 0 means there was no WAL file. A fast-growing WAL can indicate checkpoint or write pressure issues.

panels.title: SQLite backup size
panels.description: Size of the newest compressed SQLite backup, from conorganizer_sqlite_backup_size_bytes. Useful for spotting unusual database growth or a backup that is much smaller than the one before.

panels.title: Database symptom count
panels.description: Database problems in conorganizer-main's log: locked or busy database, disk I/O error (the 2 October outage), corrupt database, constraint failures and failed startup. Plain mentions of SQLite, like the startup line, do not count.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$loki_job", service="conorganizer-main"} |~ "database is locked|database is busy|disk I/O error|database disk image is malformed|constraint failed|FOREIGN KEY|could not initialize DB|integrity check failed" [$__auto])) or vector(0)

panels.title: SQLite and database logs
panels.description: Database problems in conorganizer-main's log: locked or busy database, disk I/O error (the 2 October outage), corrupt database, constraint failures and failed startup. Plain mentions of SQLite, like the startup line, do not count.

targets.expr: {job=~"$loki_job", service="conorganizer-main"} |~ "database is locked|database is busy|disk I/O error|database disk image is malformed|constraint failed|FOREIGN KEY|could not initialize DB|integrity check failed"

panels.title: TLS days remaining: main
panels.description: Blackbox TLS expiry for the public main host. Red below 14 days, yellow below 30.

panels.title: TLS days remaining: Grafana
panels.description: Blackbox TLS expiry for Grafana. Red below 14 days, yellow below 30.

panels.title: HTTP probe duration
panels.description: Blackbox probe duration for the public entrypoints.

panels.title: HTTP status code
panels.description: Blackbox HTTP status code for the public entrypoints.

panels.title: HTTP probe success
panels.description: Blackbox probe success over time. This is the user-facing symptom signal.

panels.title: Recent Caddy errors
panels.description: Caddy errors, failed reloads, and gateway errors. Prefer exact journal labels after import if they exist.

panels.title: Recent systemd/service failures
panels.description: Broad systemd failure search from journal/syslog logs.

targets.expr: {job=~"$loki_job", service!~"loki|grafana-server"} |~ "Failed to start|Failed with result|Start request repeated too quickly|Main process exited|code=exited"

panels.title: Recent Loki/Promtail/Alloy errors
panels.description: Logging pipeline errors. Important because broken logging can hide app and backup failures.

panels.title: Recent critical logs
panels.description: High-signal platform failures that can affect recovery confidence.

targets.expr: {job=~"$loki_job", service!~"loki|grafana-server"} |~ "critical|CRITICAL|panic|no space left on device|read-only file system|segfault|OOM|Out of memory" !~ "with drm panic"

panels.title: Log shipping (lines/s, Alloy → Loki)
panels.description: Lines Alloy reads from the journal and sends to Loki. Sent dropping to 0 means logs stop reaching Loki, like the two weeks in October when Alloy looped on a damaged journal file.
